content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible category: Ex-servicemen of the Armed Forces/Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs), or ex-Constables of the disbanded Haryana State Industrial Security Force (HSISF)/Haryana Armed Police (HAP) Battalions. Educational qualification: Minimum 10+2 from a recognized board. Minimum service: At least 5 years of service in the Armed Forces/CAPFs. Candidates must not have been removed/dismissed from service in the Armed Forces/CAPFs on grounds of indiscipline, misconduct, or medical unfitness. Medical category at discharge must be ‘A’. Character certificate at discharge must be ‘Exemplary/Outstanding’. Preference is given to candidates with experience handling telecommunication equipment, particularly those who served in the Signal Corps of the Armed Forces/CAPFs. As per the affidavit requirement, candidates must not have any pending criminal case in any court, and must not have been previously appointed as an SPO in any other district of Haryana.

rows.details: As on the date of advertisement

content_sections.heading: Honorarium & Benefits
content_sections.text: SPOs undergo a 15-day capsule course after selection to reorient themselves to Police Department requirements. They will not be posted at their home police station, though preference is given to the home district at deployment, subject to post availability. SPOs may be deployed anywhere in Haryana during emergent situations for short durations. No fee amount is mentioned anywhere in the official notification for this engagement.

rows.amount: ₹20,000 (credited to bank account only, no cash disbursal)
₹3,000 (for 2 sets of uniform, 1 pair of shoes, SPO insignia, cap/lanyard, etc.)
As applicable to Constables of Haryana Police

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Selection Process
content_sections.text: Important: No written or physical test will be conducted for engagement of SPOs. Candidates appear in person on the date fixed for their district with the completed application form, original documents, one set of attested photocopies, affidavit, and photographs. Documents pertaining to qualification, age, caste/category, and other certificates claimed in the application are verified from the concerned issuing authorities. Selected candidates undergo a medical examination before an appointment letter is issued. Character and antecedents of selected candidates are verified from the concerned district police authority by the Police Telecommunication Wing, Haryana, before issuing appointment letters. Selected SPOs undergo a 15-day capsule course to reorient themselves to Police Department requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Haryana Police SPO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important: There is no online application for this engagement. Candidates must apply entirely offline, in person, on the date assigned to their district. Download and fill the application form (in CAPITAL LETTERS) covering personal details, service details (enlistment/enrollment date, discharge date, medical category and character certificate at discharge), Aadhaar, PAN, bank passbook, category, education, and address details. Prepare the required affidavit declaring permanent residence, ex-servicemen/disbanded HSISF-HAP status, absence of pending criminal cases, no prior SPO appointment in another Haryana district, and willingness to serve and follow department rules. Identify the date assigned to your district from the walk-in schedule above. Report in person from 9:00 AM on that date at Police Lines Telecommunication, Opposite Sector-25, Near Village Moginand, Panchkula, Haryana, with the completed application form, affidavit, all original documents, one set of attested photocopies, and 4 passport-size colour photographs. Important: Incomplete applications will not be entertained. No application will be accepted after the prescribed date for the concerned district. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates appearing for document submission/interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form (original) All relevant original documents (service record, discharge certificate, medical category and character certificate at discharge, educational certificates, age proof, category certificate) One set of attested photocopies of all relevant documents Duly sworn affidavit as per the prescribed format Aadhaar Card photocopy PAN Card photocopy Bank Passbook photocopy 4 passport-size colour photographs

content_sections.heading: Terms & Conditions
content_sections.text: Engagement is for 1 year, or until regular appointment of personnel to these posts, whichever is earlier. SPOs will not be posted at their home police station; preference for the home district is given at deployment, subject to availability of posts. SPOs may be deployed anywhere in Haryana during emergent situations for short durations. Services can be terminated at any time before the 1-year period, without notice, on grounds of indiscipline, misconduct, unsatisfactory performance, or non-requirement, by order of the Superintendent of Police, Telecommunication. The order/decision of SP Telecommunication, Haryana is final; no appeal lies before any superior officer. The category options listed on the application form are General (GEN), BC-A, BC-B, and SC - as per Haryana state category classification.

faq.question: Q1. How many SPO posts are available?
faq.answer: 400 Special Police Officer posts are available in the Telecommunication Wing of Haryana Police.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Ex-servicemen of the Armed Forces/CAPFs, and ex-Constables of the disbanded Haryana State Industrial Security Force (HSISF)/Haryana Armed Police (HAP) Battalions, with a minimum of 5 years of service.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an online application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No. This is a walk-in, in-person application only, on the date assigned to the candidate's district.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a written or physical test?
faq.answer: No. No written or physical test will be conducted for engagement of SPOs.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 25 and 50 years of age as on the date of advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly honorarium?
faq.answer: ₹20,000 per month, credited to the SPO's bank account (no cash disbursal).

faq.question: Q7. How long is the engagement period?
faq.answer: 1 year, or until regular appointment of personnel to these posts, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Where and when should candidates report?
faq.answer: At Police Lines Telecommunication, Opposite Sector-25, Near Village Moginand, Panchkula, Haryana, from 9:00 AM onwards, on the date assigned to their district (24–27 August 2026).

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for appearing in the selection process?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid to candidates appearing for document submission/interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can services be terminated before the 1-year period ends?
faq.answer: Yes, at any time, without notice, on grounds of indiscipline, misconduct, unsatisfactory performance, or non-requirement, by order of the Superintendent of Police, Telecommunication; this decision is final with no right of appeal.
